_about: Every model change that is live but provisional, with where its setting is and the rule that decides it. scripts/whats_live.py reads each setting's current value from the code and writes docs/whats-live/index.html. Add a row here in the same pull request that applies a provisional change, and remove or move it when the recheck decides it. CONVENTIONS.md, "What's live".

applied.title: Friday weight for current-line games
applied.what: Games priced at the current line use the weight the model earns with Friday information (0.156 for 2026) in place of the game-day weight (0.290). Early lines and the final week are unchanged.
applied.unseen: NFL games kicked off after Nov 19, 2026, from the forecast log's logged inputs.
applied.rule: Comes off if that stretch is worse on average miss. Within 1 standard error either way, it stays and is judged again after 2027.
docs: FEATURES.md: Bet-time information: the Friday weight

applied.title: PFF passing grade and opponent coverage in passing yards
applied.basis: Kept under the rule; Ryan's go-ahead
applied.what: The quarterback's PFF passing grade and the opponent's PFF coverage grade are extra terms in the passing-yards calibration.
applied.off: Take pff_pass_grade and pff_opp_cov out of CAL_EXTRA["pass_yds"].
applied.rule: Comes off if worse on 2026's passing-yards RMSE, or on both 2026 Brier measures at the DraftKings/FanDuel passing-yards lines. No refit on 2026.
docs: PLAYERS.md: PFF passing grade and opponent coverage in passing yards

applied.title: WOPR standing in WR/TE receiving yards
applied.what: Receiving yards for wide receivers and tight ends projected 10+ yards are multiplied by (1 + b × z), z being how far his WOPR sits from the usual for his projection.
applied.rule: Comes off if Weeks 11 on are worse on bet-time RMSE, on bet-time Typical Brier, or at the live WR/TE receiving-yards main lines. A mixed result on the other measures goes to Ryan. Constants are refitted only after that decision.
docs: PLAYERS.md: WOPR standing in WR/TE receiving yards

applied.title: Role change in the prop spread
applied.basis: Ryan's call; the two pieces that nearly passed, by stat
applied.what: The spread of a prop's distribution widens after a role change: NFL receptions and receiving yards (WR, TE, RB) and college carries and rushing yards (RB).
applied.off: Empty the league's list in rolechange.APPLIED and refit the prop parameters.
applied.unseen: The 2026 season (the stat split was chosen after seeing 2017-2025).
applied.rule: A piece comes off if 2026 is worse on its main lines (game-day and bet-time) or on its floor rungs. Anything mixed goes to Ryan.
docs: FEATURES.md: Prop spread that widens after a role change

applied.title: Offensive-line names matched loosely
applied.basis: Ryan's call after a flat test
applied.what: A lineman the snap counts, roster and injury report spell differently (a dropped "Jr.", "DJ" for "Delmar") no longer counts as missing every week.
applied.unseen: The 2026 season, with the PFF data.
docs: FEATURES.md: Offensive-line input: linemen the name match loses

applied.title: Market-residual margin
applied.what: The adjusted college spread is the line plus a ridge fit of (result − line) on the margin inputs and the line, recent seasons weighted more, in place of one blend weight. Early lines and totals are unchanged.
applied.off: Set STACK_MARGIN = False (restores the blend weight).
applied.unseen: College games kicked off after Nov 19, 2026 (about 300 with bowls).
applied.rule: Comes off if the post-Nov 19 average miss or RMS miss is worse. A mixed result on side win rate or bet-time miss goes to Ryan. No refit of the penalty or half-life on 2026.

applied.title: PFF skill and matchup inputs
applied.basis: Kept under the rule; Ryan's go-ahead
applied.what: Passing yards get the quarterback's PFF passing grade and the opponent's coverage grade; receiving yards get yards per route run and opponent coverage; receptions get opponent coverage.
applied.off: Remove the pair's line from CAL_EXTRA in cfbmodel/players.py.
applied.unseen: The 2026 season (the pairs were chosen from 14 candidates on 2017-2025).
applied.rule: A pair comes off if it is worse on 2026's RMSE or at 2026's live main lines. No refit on 2026.
docs: FEATURES.md: PFF tables in the college projections

applied.title: Quarterbacks on big underdogs
applied.what: A quarterback's passing yards come down a fixed number of yards for each point his team is projected to lose by beyond the margin, from the 2026 season.
applied.unseen: College games kicked off after Nov 19, 2026.
applied.rule: Comes off if the post-Nov 19 RMSE on all starters is worse, or the live passing-yards lines are worse by more than 1 standard error. Anything mixed goes to Ryan. A different threshold or shape needs a new pre-set test.

applied.title: QB rushing chance shift
applied.basis: Kept under the rule; Ryan's go-ahead
applied.what: The chance on a college quarterback's rushing-yards prop is shifted on the logit scale before it is shown.
applied.off: Remove the rush_yds|QB entry from chance_shift in data/cfb/prop_params.json.
applied.unseen: The 2026 season's live college QB rushing lines.
applied.rule: Comes off if the shifted chance is worse on 2026's main lines. A different refitted value needs a new pre-set test, not a quiet update.
docs: FEATURES.md: Correcting the college QB rushing chance

applied.title: Model nudge on Parlays main-line legs
applied.what: Two-sided college main lines on the Parlays page are priced part of the way from the books' number to the model's, up to a cap. Value is still scored on the books' number.
applied.off: A stat comes off through CFB_NUDGE_STATS.
applied.unseen: The full 2026 season's logged chances (through Nov 12 was read when it was applied).
applied.rule: Removed if the 2026 all-stats Brier is worse than the books. If all-stats is better but one stat is worse by more than 1 standard error, that stat comes off and it goes to Ryan. Same weight and cap: no refit on 2026.
docs: FEATURES.md: The model nudge on college main lines

groups.title: Everything kept Nov 4 to Nov 10, 2026 under the old "any improvement" rule
groups.what: Kept with no noise threshold, on seasons the tests had seen. Named in the rechecks list as: the Nov 4 college and NFL game-model additions, PFF route share, the PFF quarterback prior, transfer-aware returning production, the quarterback rushing and kneel-down changes, the Questionable shades, the over-lean shade, and the rest dated Nov 4 on in FEATURES.md, CFB_FEATURES.md, PLAYERS.md and PROPS.md.
groups.rule: Each is judged on the 2026 season alone, the only season none of them was chosen on, and removed if worse there. Player changes are scored on bet-time projections as well as game-day ones.
groups.note: These are not itemised with their settings yet. The January task works from the four test logs.

waiting.title: Totals cap on the model's weight
waiting.why: Raising it to 0.15 was mixed on the seasons tested (Nov 11, 2026). Ryan: leave at 0.05.
waiting.rule: 2026 is the season none of the caps was chosen on: blend total miss and the flagged totals' return at 0.05 against 0.15.

waiting.title: Alternate-line reading for ladder rungs
waiting.why: Fitted on 2025's rungs and never checked on rungs it didn't see. A Nov 13 refit was not kept.
waiting.rule: On 2026's live rungs, in every probability band with 100+ rungs the cleared share must be within 2 standard errors of the reading. Otherwise refit.

waiting.title: Anytime-TD margin
waiting.rule: On 2026's live TD prices: is 17.5% still the best-fitting margin?

waiting.title: Prop distribution widths fitted on college misses
waiting.why: Applied Nov 4, 2026 (near-miss #6): better on all four stats at the 2025 lines.
waiting.rule: The 2026 live-log recheck still stands: Brier at 2026's live college lines against the earlier widths.
